name: Porcelain Material Study
purpose: Provide a first-party artifact scene for future transfer replications involving material physics, medium anchoring, artifact state, lighting response, and object-centered composition.
first_party_baseline_prompt: Create a museum-style object study of a hand-thrown blue-and-white porcelain ewer on a neutral linen-covered plinth. The vessel has a clearly readable silhouette, a curved handle, a narrow neck, and cobalt underglaze decoration that follows the curvature of the body beneath a translucent glaze. Use soft side lighting to reveal glaze depth, firing softness, minor surface irregularity, and curved-surface distortion of the painted motif without making the object look like glossy plastic. Keep the background quiet and the object centered with enough negative space to inspect its form.

allowed_experimental_mutation_points.description: Reserved transfer slot for a future material-name-only versus visible material-physics replication.
Reserved transfer slot for a future medium-name-only versus physical medium-behavior replication.

provenance.notes: The prompt is newly authored for AIPF. Private source material informed mechanism selection only; source wording, prompt IDs, images, and creator-specific composition are not embedded.
